items.title: Script header with strict mode
items.description: Shebang plus fail-fast options.

items.title: What set -euo pipefail does
items.body:
set -e          # exit when a command fails
set -u          # error on unset variables
set -o pipefail # a pipeline fails if any command in it fails
items.description: Meaning of each strict-mode flag.

items.title: Default values and required variables
items.body:
name="${1:-World}"                 # default if unset or empty
: "${API_KEY:?API_KEY is required}"  # abort with a message if unset
items.description: Fall back to a default or abort when a variable is missing.

items.title: if with file and string tests
items.body:
if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then echo "file exists"
elif [[ -d "$file" ]]; then echo "directory"
else echo "missing"; fi

# -z empty string   -n non-empty   -e exists   -r readable   -x executable
items.description: Common [[ ]] conditions.

items.title: Compare numbers and strings
items.body:
if (( count > 10 )); then echo "big"; fi
if [[ "$a" == "$b" ]]; then echo "equal"; fi
if [[ "$name" == prefix* ]]; then echo "starts with prefix"; fi
if [[ "$s" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo "all digits"; fi
items.description: Use (( )) for numbers and [[ ]] for strings.

items.title: for loop over files
items.body:
for f in *.txt; do
  echo "Processing $f"
done
items.description: Iterate a glob safely (quote the variable).

items.title: for loop over a number range
items.body:
for i in {1..5}; do echo "$i"; done

for ((i = 0; i < 5; i++)); do echo "$i"; done
items.description: Counting loops, brace and C style.

items.title: Read a file line by line
items.body:
while IFS= read -r line; do
  echo "$line"
done < input.txt
items.description: Preserves whitespace and backslashes.

items.title: Function with arguments and return value
items.body:
greet() {
  local name="${1:-World}"
  echo "Hello, $name"
}

msg=$(greet "Ada")   # capture output
echo "$msg"
if greet >/dev/null; then echo "ok"; fi
items.description: Arguments are $1, $2...; output via echo, status via return.

items.title: Parse short options with getopts
items.description: Handle -f value, -v and -h.

items.title: Parse long options with a while/case loop
items.description: Handle --name value style flags.

items.title: Special variables
items.body:
$0 script name   $1..$9 arguments   $# argument count
"$@" all args (each quoted)   $? last exit status
$$ current PID   $! last background PID
items.description: Arguments, exit status and process info.

items.title: Clean up with trap
items.body:
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT
items.description: Remove a temp dir however the script exits.

items.title: Check that a command exists
items.body: command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "git is required" >&2; exit 1; }
items.description: Fail early when a dependency is missing.

items.title: Arrays
items.body:
arr=(apple banana cherry)
echo "${arr[0]}"            # first element
echo "${#arr[@]}"           # length
arr+=(date)                 # append
for x in "${arr[@]}"; do echo "$x"; done
items.description: Create, loop, count and append.

items.title: Parameter expansion cheats
items.description: Strip prefixes/suffixes and change case without external tools.

items.title: Redirection cheat sheet
items.body:
cmd > out.txt          # stdout to file (overwrite)
cmd >> out.txt         # append
cmd 2> err.txt         # stderr to file
cmd > all.txt 2>&1     # both to one file
cmd &> all.txt         # same, shorter (bash)
cmd > /dev/null 2>&1   # discard everything
echo "error" >&2       # write to stderr
items.description: Send output and errors where you need them.

items.title: Here document
items.body:
cat > config.txt <<'EOF'
line one with $literal dollar
line two
EOF
items.description: Write multi-line text to a file; quote EOF to stop expansion.

items.title: One-liner: rename extensions
items.body: for f in *.txt; do mv -- "$f" "${f%.txt}.md"; done
items.description: Change every .txt file to .md.

items.title: One-liner: most frequent lines
items.body: sort file.txt | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10
items.description: Count duplicates and show the top ten.

items.title: One-liner: delete old files
items.body: find . -name '*.log' -mtime +7 -delete
items.description: Remove .log files older than 7 days (preview without -delete first).

items.title: One-liner: run in parallel
items.body: ls *.png | xargs -P 4 -I {} convert {} {}.jpg
items.description: Process files four at a time.

items.title: Debug a script
items.body:
bash -x script.sh
# or inside the script:
set -x
items.description: Trace every command as it runs.
